channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Xavier Henry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Xavier Henry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Xavier Henry
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Kobe on Henry’s Achilles:

“I knew exactly what he was feeling - took me back to that place again. It’s an uphill battle. It’s a long hill.”

Kobe Bryant on Xavier Henry, Nov 25, 2014. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Xavier Henry
item.description:
“Xavier earned a spot on our team last season after being a training camp invitee, and we hope he continues the dedication to improving he has displayed for us thus far,”

Mitch Kupchak on Xavier Henry, Jul 25, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Monty Williams on Xavier Henry
item.description:
“Xavier is a guy who, when he’s healthy, is going to play for us because he can do a number of things on the floor,”

Monty Williams on Xavier Henry, Jan 5, 2012. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.
